title: About us
intro: Based in the East End of London since 1884, Toynbee Hall is a charity working alongside people facing poverty, injustice and inequality to build a fairer East London.

blocks.heading: Our vision
paragraphs: A fairer future with an end to poverty, injustice and inequality.

blocks.heading: Our mission
paragraphs: We address poverty and injustice through advice and support, influence systemic change, shift power to people and communities, and collaborate to build fairer systems.

blocks.heading: Our values
paragraphs: Inclusive, courageous and empowering. We are open-minded, act with integrity, share knowledge and enable people to take action for themselves.
